name: structure/agent-frontmatter

input.name: reviewer
input.description: Reviews a change and reports problems, never edits.

yaml:
name: reviewer
description: Reviews a change and reports problems, never edits.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash
model: sonnet
permissionMode: plan
skills:
  - gr-rust
  - add-acceptance-test
isolation: worktree
memory: project

name: structure/agent-native-map
yaml:
name: architect
description: Plans work.
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: Bash
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: echo hi
mcpServers:
  backlog:
    command: backlog
    args:
      - mcp
      - start
    env:
      A: "1"
maxTurns: 25
background: true
